prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A striking close-up portrait of a young man with light brown hair styled in a tousled, modern fashion, gazing intensely into the camera with piercing, light-colored eyes. He is posed dramatically, leaning forward with one arm extended across a vivid red surface, his hand partially obscuring his mouth, while his other hand rests on his head, fingers tangled in his hair. His expression is fierce and captivating, lips slightly parted to reveal a hint of silver dental jewelry, adding an edgy, rebellious flair. He wears a fitted black top adorned with elaborate silver chains and metallic accessories that catch the light, creating a sense of luxury and boldness. The background is deep black, isolating the subject and heightening the sense of drama. The lighting is soft yet focused, casting gentle highlights on his face and metallic details, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and draws all attention to his intense gaze and intricate styling. The overall mood is cinematic and high-fashion, with a cool, slightly desaturated color palette punctuated by the vivid red foreground, evoking a sense of mystery, allure, and modern glamour.
